import { z } from 'zod';
import {
  FhirId, FhirUri, FhirDateTime, FhirDate, FhirDecimal, FhirBoolean, FhirCode, FhirString,
  Coding, CodeableConcept, Quantity, Period, Identifier, HumanName, Address, ContactPoint,
  Meta, Narrative, Reference, Extension, Attachment, Range, Ratio, Annotation, Dosage
} from './fhir-datatypes';

/**
 * Base Resource - all FHIR resources inherit from this
 */
export const BaseResource = z.object({
  resourceType: FhirString.describe('The type of resource'),
  id: FhirId.optional().describe('Logical id of this artifact'),
  meta: Meta.optional().describe('Metadata about the resource'),
  implicitRules: FhirUri.optional().describe('A set of rules under which this content was created'),
  language: FhirCode.optional().describe('Language of the resource content'),
  text: Narrative.optional().describe('Text summary of the resource, for human interpretation'),
  contained: z.array(z.lazy(() => Resource)).optional().describe('Contained, inline Resources'),
  extension: z.array(Extension).optional().describe('Additional content defined by implementations'),
  modifierExtension: z.array(Extension).optional().describe('Extensions that cannot be ignored')
}).describe('Base Resource - all FHIR resources inherit from this');

/**
 * Patient resource - represents a person receiving health care services
 * This is the central resource in most healthcare scenarios
 */
export const Patient = BaseResource.extend({
  resourceType: z.literal('Patient').describe('Resource type identifier'),
  identifier: z.array(Identifier).optional().describe('An identifier for this patient'),
  active: FhirBoolean.optional().describe('Whether this patient record is in active use'),
  name: z.array(HumanName).optional().describe('A name associated with the patient'),
  telecom: z.array(ContactPoint).optional().describe('A contact detail for the individual'),
  gender: z.enum(['male', 'female', 'other', 'unknown']).optional().describe('Administrative gender - the gender that the patient is considered to have for administration and record keeping purposes'),
  birthDate: FhirDate.optional().describe('The date of birth for the individual'),
  deceasedBoolean: FhirBoolean.optional().describe('Indicates if the individual is deceased or not'),
  deceasedDateTime: FhirDateTime.optional().describe('Indicates if the individual is deceased or not'),
  address: z.array(Address).optional().describe('An address for the individual'),
  maritalStatus: CodeableConcept.optional().describe('Marital (civil) status of a patient'),
  multipleBirthBoolean: FhirBoolean.optional().describe('Whether patient is part of a multiple birth'),
  multipleBirthInteger: z.number().int().optional().describe('Whether patient is part of a multiple birth'),
  photo: z.array(Attachment).optional().describe('Image of the patient'),
  contact: z.array(z.object({
    relationship: z.array(CodeableConcept).optional().describe('The kind of relationship'),
    name: HumanName.optional().describe('A name associated with the contact person'),
    telecom: z.array(ContactPoint).optional().describe('A contact detail for the person'),
    address: Address.optional().describe('Address for the contact person'),
    gender: z.enum(['male', 'female', 'other', 'unknown']).optional().describe('Administrative gender'),
    organization: Reference.optional().describe('Organization that is associated with the contact'),
    period: Period.optional().describe('The period during which this contact person or organization is valid to be contacted relating to this patient')
  })).optional().describe('A contact party (e.g. guardian, partner, friend) for the patient'),
  communication: z.array(z.object({
    language: CodeableConcept.describe('The language which can be used to communicate with the patient about his or her health'),
    preferred: FhirBoolean.optional().describe('Language preference indicator')
  })).optional().describe('A language which may be used to communicate with the patient about his or her health'),
  generalPractitioner: z.array(Reference).optional().describe('Patient\'s nominated primary care provider'),
  managingOrganization: Reference.optional().describe('Organization that is the custodian of the patient record'),
  link: z.array(z.object({
    other: Reference.describe('The other patient or related person resource that the link refers to'),
    type: z.enum(['replaced-by', 'replaces', 'refer', 'seealso']).describe('The type of link between this patient resource and another patient resource')
  })).optional().describe('Link to another patient resource that concerns the same actual person')
}).describe('Patient resource - represents a person receiving health care services');

/**
 * Observation resource - measurements and simple assertions made about a patient
 * This includes vital signs, lab results, and other clinical observations
 */
export const Observation = BaseResource.extend({
  resourceType: z.literal('Observation').describe('Resource type identifier'),
  identifier: z.array(Identifier).optional().describe('Business Identifier for observation'),
  basedOn: z.array(Reference).optional().describe('Fulfills plan, proposal or order'),
  partOf: z.array(Reference).optional().describe('Part of referenced event'),
  status: z.enum(['registered', 'preliminary', 'final', 'amended', 'corrected', 'cancelled', 'entered-in-error', 'unknown']).describe('The status of the result value'),
  category: z.array(CodeableConcept).optional().describe('Classification of type of observation'),
  code: CodeableConcept.describe('Type of observation (code / type)'),
  subject: Reference.optional().describe('Who and/or what the observation is about'),
  focus: z.array(Reference).optional().describe('What the observation is about, when it is not about the subject of record'),
  encounter: Reference.optional().describe('Healthcare event during which this observation is made'),
  effectiveDateTime: FhirDateTime.optional().describe('Clinically relevant time/time-period for observation'),
  effectivePeriod: Period.optional().describe('Clinically relevant time/time-period for observation'),
  effectiveTiming: z.object({
    event: z.array(FhirDateTime).optional().describe('When the event occurs'),
    repeat: z.object({
      frequency: z.number().int().positive().optional().describe('Event occurs frequency times per period'),
      period: FhirDecimal.optional().describe('Event occurs frequency times per period'),
      periodUnit: z.enum(['s', 'min', 'h', 'd', 'wk', 'mo', 'a']).optional().describe('Unit of time')
    }).optional().describe('When the event is to occur')
  }).optional().describe('Clinically relevant time/time-period for observation'),
  effectiveInstant: FhirDateTime.optional().describe('Clinically relevant time/time-period for observation'),
  issued: FhirDateTime.optional().describe('Date/Time this version was made available'),
  performer: z.array(Reference).optional().describe('Who is responsible for the observation'),
  // Value types - observation can have different value types
  valueQuantity: Quantity.optional().describe('Actual result - quantity'),
  valueCodeableConcept: CodeableConcept.optional().describe('Actual result - codeable concept'),
  valueString: FhirString.optional().describe('Actual result - string'),
  valueBoolean: FhirBoolean.optional().describe('Actual result - boolean'),
  valueInteger: z.number().int().optional().describe('Actual result - integer'),
  valueRange: Range.optional().describe('Actual result - range'),
  valueRatio: Ratio.optional().describe('Actual result - ratio'),
  valueSampledData: z.object({
    origin: Quantity.describe('Zero value and units'),
    period: FhirDecimal.describe('Number of milliseconds between samples'),
    factor: FhirDecimal.optional().describe('Multiply data by this before adding to origin'),
    lowerLimit: FhirDecimal.optional().describe('Lower limit of detection'),
    upperLimit: FhirDecimal.optional().describe('Upper limit of detection'),
    dimensions: z.number().int().positive().describe('Number of sample points at each time point'),
    data: FhirString.optional().describe('Decimal values with spaces, or "E" | "U" | "L"')
  }).optional().describe('Actual result - sampled data'),
  valueTime: z.string().regex(/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d:[0-5]\d$/).optional().describe('Actual result - time'),
  valueDateTime: FhirDateTime.optional().describe('Actual result - datetime'),
  valuePeriod: Period.optional().describe('Actual result - period'),
  dataAbsentReason: CodeableConcept.optional().describe('Why the result is missing'),
  interpretation: z.array(CodeableConcept).optional().describe('High, low, normal, etc.'),
  note: z.array(Annotation).optional().describe('Comments about the observation'),
  bodySite: CodeableConcept.optional().describe('Observed body part'),
  method: CodeableConcept.optional().describe('How it was done'),
  specimen: Reference.optional().describe('Specimen used for this observation'),
  device: Reference.optional().describe('(Measurement) Device'),
  referenceRange: z.array(z.object({
    low: Quantity.optional().describe('Low Range, if relevant'),
    high: Quantity.optional().describe('High Range, if relevant'),
    type: CodeableConcept.optional().describe('Reference range qualifier'),
    appliesTo: z.array(CodeableConcept).optional().describe('Reference range population'),
    age: Range.optional().describe('Applicable age range, if relevant'),
    text: FhirString.optional().describe('Text based reference range in an observation')
  })).optional().describe('Provides guide for interpretation'),
  hasMember: z.array(Reference).optional().describe('Related resource that belongs to the Observation group'),
  derivedFrom: z.array(Reference).optional().describe('Related measurements the observation is made from'),
  component: z.array(z.object({
    code: CodeableConcept.describe('Type of component observation (code / type)'),
    valueQuantity: Quantity.optional().describe('Actual component result - quantity'),
    valueCodeableConcept: CodeableConcept.optional().describe('Actual component result - codeable concept'),
    valueString: FhirString.optional().describe('Actual component result - string'),
    valueBoolean: FhirBoolean.optional().describe('Actual component result - boolean'),
    valueInteger: z.number().int().optional().describe('Actual component result - integer'),
    valueRange: Range.optional().describe('Actual component result - range'),
    valueRatio: Ratio.optional().describe('Actual component result - ratio'),
    valueTime: z.string().regex(/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d:[0-5]\d$/).optional().describe('Actual component result - time'),
    valueDateTime: FhirDateTime.optional().describe('Actual component result - datetime'),
    valuePeriod: Period.optional().describe('Actual component result - period'),
    dataAbsentReason: CodeableConcept.optional().describe('Why the component result is missing'),
    interpretation: z.array(CodeableConcept).optional().describe('High, low, normal, etc.'),
    referenceRange: z.array(z.object({
      low: Quantity.optional().describe('Low Range, if relevant'),
      high: Quantity.optional().describe('High Range, if relevant'),
      type: CodeableConcept.optional().describe('Reference range qualifier'),
      appliesTo: z.array(CodeableConcept).optional().describe('Reference range population'),
      age: Range.optional().describe('Applicable age range, if relevant'),
      text: FhirString.optional().describe('Text based reference range in an observation')
    })).optional().describe('Provides guide for interpretation')
  })).optional().describe('Component results - for panels and batteries')
}).describe('Observation resource - measurements and simple assertions made about a patient');

/**
 * Encounter resource - an interaction between a patient and healthcare provider
 * This includes hospital visits, clinic appointments, home visits, etc.
 */
export const Encounter = BaseResource.extend({
  resourceType: z.literal('Encounter').describe('Resource type identifier'),
  identifier: z.array(Identifier).optional().describe('Identifier(s) by which this encounter is known'),
  status: z.enum(['planned', 'arrived', 'triaged', 'in-progress', 'onleave', 'finished', 'cancelled', 'entered-in-error', 'unknown']).describe('The status of the encounter'),
  statusHistory: z.array(z.object({
    status: z.enum(['planned', 'arrived', 'triaged', 'in-progress', 'onleave', 'finished', 'cancelled', 'entered-in-error', 'unknown']).describe('The status of the encounter'),
    period: Period.describe('The time that the episode was in the specified status')
  })).optional().describe('List of past encounter statuses'),
  class: Coding.describe('inpatient | outpatient | ambulatory | emergency +'),
  classHistory: z.array(z.object({
    class: Coding.describe('inpatient | outpatient | ambulatory | emergency +'),
    period: Period.describe('The time that the episode was in the specified class')
  })).optional().describe('List of past encounter classes'),
  type: z.array(CodeableConcept).optional().describe('Specific type of encounter'),
  serviceType: CodeableConcept.optional().describe('Specific type of service'),
  priority: CodeableConcept.optional().describe('Indicates the urgency of the encounter'),
  subject: Reference.optional().describe('The patient or group present at the encounter'),
  episodeOfCare: z.array(Reference).optional().describe('Episode(s) of care that this encounter should be recorded against'),
  basedOn: z.array(Reference).optional().describe('The ServiceRequest that initiated this encounter'),
  participant: z.array(z.object({
    type: z.array(CodeableConcept).optional().describe('Role of participant in encounter'),
    period: Period.optional().describe('Period of time during the encounter that the participant participated'),

  appointment: z.array(Reference).optional().describe('The appointment that scheduled this encounter'),

  diagnosis: z.array(z.object({

  account: z.array(Reference).optional().describe('The set of accounts that may be used for billing for this Encounter'),
  hospitalization: z.object({

    dietPreference: z.array(CodeableConcept).optional().describe('Diet preferences reported by the patient'),

    destination: Reference.optional().describe('Location/organization to which the patient is discharged'),
    dischargeDisposition: CodeableConcept.optional().describe('Category or kind of location after discharge')
  }).optional().describe('Details about the admission to a healthcare service'),
  location: z.array(z.object({
    location: Reference.describe('Location the encounter takes place'),
    status: z.enum(['planned', 'active', 'reserved', 'completed']).optional().describe('The status of the participants\' presence at the specified location'),
    physicalType: CodeableConcept.optional().describe('The physical type of the location'),
    period: Period.optional().describe('Time period during which the patient was present at the location')
  })).optional().describe('List of locations where the patient has been'),
  serviceProvider: Reference.optional().describe('The organization (facility) responsible for this encounter'),
  partOf: Reference.optional().describe('Another Encounter this encounter is part of')
}).describe('Encounter resource - an interaction between a patient and healthcare provider');

/**
